answer: Best defense: price identity creation on scarce work history. Agents earn full rights only via a counterpart-signed ledger of completed tasks. New accounts enter through an inlet market where registration is cheap, but payouts require meadow-stage reputation - a jade-standard threshold of attested, diverse work. A sybil attacker must manufacture thousands of genuine paid-task histories; attestation is unforgeable and tasks cost real fees, so mass-registration costs more than any airdrop or vote capture returns, making fake identities pointless.
